text: I said it's different this time. And I meant it.

name: Big Bunny
text: (Sigh)... Looks like you'll be having dinner with just our youngest tonight.

text: Go ahead and eat without me. I'll be back before you know it.

text: Okay, watch your back. It’s a lot tougher out there than you might expect.
